Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text:
In the name of God, the Most Gracious, the
Most Merciful.

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text:
We are recording this program in January
of 1986.

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text:
A couple of months ago, around November
1985, a book appeared in bookstores

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text:
across the nation that soon became a
best-seller.

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text:
The book is a fictitious novel, narrating
the arrival, monitoring of a coded

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text: message from outer space

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text:
that proved the existence of a super
intelligence out there trying to contact

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text:
us on earth.
The message was decoded by computers.

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text:
And the novel - this fictitious novel - even
supports all-time religions' belief in

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text:
God.
The novel is "Contact."

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text:
You probably saw this book,
"Contact" by Carl Sagan.

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text:
And there are only four quotations that
I would like to share with you in this

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text:
book. The first quotation appears on the
front flap of the book and it says

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text:
"in Contact, Carl Sagan, whose cosmos
enthralled millions of readers

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text:
and television viewers, has brilliantly
employed the freedom of fiction

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text:
to imagine the greatest adventure of all;
humanity's first encounter with other

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text: intelligent beings."

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text:
The second quotation appears on page 219.
And it describes the computer decoding

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text: of this message as

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text:
"This is only the most amazing
discovery in the history of the world."

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text: Let me repeat this quotation.

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text:
It describes the computer decoding of the
message like this "This is only the most

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text: amazing discovery in the history of the world."

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text:
The third quotation that I would like to
share with you, appears at the end of the

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text: novel, page 430, where we find the conclusion of the

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text:
whole novel.
And here it is "There is an intelligence

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text:
that antedates the universe." In other
words, the novel is trying to say that

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text:
there is God out there.
"There is an intelligence that antedates

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text:
the universe." The last quotation that I
wish to share with you

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text:
is non-fictitious. It is not fiction at all.
It is Carl Sagan's notes

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text: at the end of the book.

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text:
Carl Sagan says, in his... in the author's
note "My fondest hope for this book

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text:
is that it will be made obsolete by the
pace of real scientific discovery."

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text:
Well, ladies and gentlemen, Carl Sagan's
fondest hope has just come true.

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text:
In the next 50 minutes or so, I will
share with you the real scientific

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text:
discovery of a coded message from outer
space, from deep space. And the message

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text:
will represent the first physical
evidence ever for the existence of God.

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text:
We have been talking about God, and those
who believe in God have been presenting

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text:
circumstantial evidence. But now, we are
going to witness a miracle. We are going

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text: to witness physical evidence, the first

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text:
incontrovertible evidence that God
exists. And we are going to see this

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text:
proof through the real
scientific discovery of a coded

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text:
message that came to us and could never
be human-made.

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text:
Before I get to the historical
development of this message, and the

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text:
monitoring and decoding of it, I would
like to make a couple of statements

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text:
that I consider very important.
The first statement is that every

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text:
utterance you are going to hear in this
program

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text:
is a proven scientific fact.
Every statement you are going to hear

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text:
is proven by means of a mathematical code
that gives us, provides us with physical

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text:
evidence that every statement is correct.
It is very important that you have full

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text:
confidence that every statement here
is proven

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text:
by physical evidence.
The reason I'm saying this is that some

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text:
of the statements you are going to hear
had in the past

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text:
provoked ridicule or snickering or some
laughter. This will no longer be the case.

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text:
You see, the message came to this world
in many parts, and the first part came

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text:
to us through the first man, Adam. Adam was
created by God, and he knew about God

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text:
and when he came to this world, he
transmitted the first portion of the

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text:
message.
The purpose of the message as you will

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text:
see is to tell us where we came from, why
we are here, where we are going, the

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text: purpose of our existence. So, Adam taught his children

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text:
and grandchildren about God, and everything
he knew about the creation of Adam,

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text:
the creation of the human being, the creation
of his wife, Eve, and how he came from

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text:
up there to the planet Earth. That is a very
important part of the message.

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text:
The message, afterwards,
came to us through every

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text:
messenger of God: Noah, Abraham, Moses,
Jesus, Muhammad. And I will go through the

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text: stages of development of the message and

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text:
show you the mathematical code that was
embedded in these messages.

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text:
What happened was that God picked out
from every generation a human being

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text:
through whom God sent part of the
message. We are talking about one and the

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text: same message.

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text:
Abraham, Moses, David, Solomon, Jesus,
Muhammad, all these people received parts

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text:
of one and the same message. And as a
proof of authenticity, as it turns out,

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text:
and as you will witness in this program,
God incorporated in His message to us

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text:
an intricate mathematical code. Intricate
beyond human ability, just to prove

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text:
that this message is not fabricated by any
human being.

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text:
Abraham contributed a good portion of that
message.

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text:
And you know,
you probably watched the movie "the Ten

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text: Commandments." You know that Moses was walking in the

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text:
desert when he saw the burning bush, and
God communicated with Moses.

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text:
God communicated part of that message. It
was a very significant part - part that we

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text:
call today the Torah.
You saw in the movie and you read in the

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text:
Bible how the tablets were, were written,
were recorded, that the scripture

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text:
was recorded on the tablets. That scripture, in
the language of Moses, was mathematically

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text:
coded beyond human ability, and this
is what this program is all about.

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text:
The discovery of a mathematical code
embedded within God's message to us

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text: through His messengers.

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text:
The first hint - let me go back to Moses,
when he carried the tablet with the

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text:
message on them, the letters on those
tablets were counted according to

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text:
an intricate mathematical code, the same
mathematical code that was discovered

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text: in all the scriptures.

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text:
The message given to Jesus, in his
language, Aramaic, was also mathematically

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text:
coded in that language. The alphabet
letters of that message were counted

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text:
and carefully placed.
The whole message in Aramaic was

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text:
composed according to a mathematical
pattern. And this is the pattern that was

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text:
consistent through every part of the
message, from Adam to Abraham, Noah, before

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text:
that, Moses, David, Solomon, Jesus, Muhammad.
The same mathematical code, the letters,

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text:
the words, the verses, everything was
calculated and carefully placed to prove

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text: that the message is from God.

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text:
The first hint of the discovery of a
mathematical code was, at least what we

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text:
know of, was announced about 1000 years
ago. And this was printed recently in a

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text:
book called "Studies in Jewish Mysticism." 
"Studies in Jewish Mysticism."

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text:
And I'm going to read for you a quotation
from that book "No change can be

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text:
tolerated in the text of the prayers, not
even a minute one, because every change,

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text:
even of one letter,
would destroy the numerical harmony

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text:
inherent in the text." That was the first
hint of a mathematical code in God's

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text:
message to the world.
Here is another quotation from the

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text:
same book, and this quotation also was
written about 900 years ago.

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text:
"According to Rabbi Judah and the
Ashkenazi Hasidic school in general,

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text:
there can be nothing accidental in the
Bible, not even the forms of letters,

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text:
the punctuation, the vocalization, and
especially in the numerical structures."

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text:
How do you like that? 900 years ago marks
the first discovery of a mathematical

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text:
code in the scriptures.
And I will go through the details

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text:
of this amazing mathematical code, and how
it penetrates and encodes the complete

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text:
scripture of God. Of course, I'm talking
about the original scripture, not any

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text:
translation. We are talking about the
original words of God in the languages

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text: of God's messengers: Adam, Abraham, Moses, David, Solomon, many many others,

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text:
Jesus, Muhammad. And the original
scripture was coded according to this

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text: very intricate miraculous system.

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text:
How in the world are we going to study
the original scriptures given to Abraham,

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text:
Moses, David, Jesus and Muhammad?
The mathematical code that God put

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text:
in His message to the world,
is in the original scripture, the original

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text:
words, letters, verses that were
written by God Almighty in those

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text:
scriptures. In Abraham's scripture, in his
original language, Moses' scripture, in his

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text:
original language and so on.
How are we going to study the original

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text:
scripture given to Jesus in Aramaic, his
language?

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text:
Well, there is only one scripture in the
world today that is original and still

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text:
intact, and that is the Quran. Back in the
year 610 AD, God picked out a man named

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text:
Muhammad and communicated with us
through him, by giving him the Quran.

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text:
And Quran today is the only original intact
scripture in the original language

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text:
as written by God Almighty.
The Quran represents the latest edition

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text:
of the scripture. Remember, we are talking
about one and the same message.

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text:
And the mathematical code that I will
share with you today

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text:
was throughout the whole message,
in the Torah, in the Gospel of Jesus, in the Quran,

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text:
in the Psalms. And as I mentioned... I mentioned
to you glimpses of the

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text:
mathematical code that were written
about, about a thousand years ago.

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text:
Back in 1968, I noticed that the Quran
had

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text:
mysterious letters at the beginning of
certain chapters. For example, chapter 2,

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text:
begins... the first verse is only three
letters A.L.M. "What is A.L.M.?" I wondered.

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text:
29 chapters in Quran have these
mysterious letters. Chapter 50

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text: is entitled Q. That's it, Q. and is prefixed with the letter Q, nothing else, Q.

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text:
Chapter 68 is prefixed with the letter N.
Chapter 36 is prefixed with the

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text:
letter, letters Y.S. and so on. These letters
remained mysterious for 1,400 years

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text: since 610 AD.

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text:
Well, curiosity led me to put the Quran
in the computer just to find out what

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text:
these letters represent. So, I wrote the
Quran in the computer. Of course, the

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text: Quran in the original language is Arabic, remember? And the computers when back in

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text:
1968, they didn't have Arabic computers.
So, what I did,  I took every Arabic letter

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text:
in the Quran and I used an English
letter to represent the Arabic letter.

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text:
And I put the whole scripture, the final
edition of God's message to the world

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text:
in the computer. Then, I asked the
computer for a number of mathematical

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text:
characteristics. The number of every
letter in every chapter, the numbers of

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text:
words, and all kinds of questions.
I had no idea what to expect.

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text: And when the computer was through and answering my questions, a very intricate

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text:
mathematical pattern emerged, and fit
with the older findings of mathematical

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text:
codes in the original scriptures of
Moses, Jesus, David, and so on.

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text:
The mathematical code that emerged
provides

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text:
the first physical evidence for the
existence of God.

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text: In fact, once you study this mathematical

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text:
pattern in detail and understand it, you
will no longer believe in God. You will

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text:
know that God exists. You will
need faith no longer. So, that's how

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text:
intricate and how miraculous
this mathematical code is.

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text:
As it turns out, these mysterious letters
have specific counts in their chapters.

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text:
And there was one common denominator in
the whole scripture that is common to

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text:
all these letters. We're talking about
exactly half the Quran. The Quran

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text:
is about 500 pages of the regular-sized
pages, and the mysterious letters prefix

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text:
29 chapters that represent, in size,
about half the Quran. The Quran consists

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text:
of 114 chapters, many of them are short
chapters, but these mysterious letters

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text:
prefix about half the Quran and it
turned out that every single set

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text:
of these mysterious letters is found in
its chapter in multiples of 19, without

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text:
a single exception. In other words, the
letters are distributed within Quran

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text:
according to this intricate mathematical
pattern that is way beyond the human

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text: ability. When you study it in detail, you

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text:
will have no doubt whatsoever that there
is a mathematical system proving the

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text:
authenticity of Quran as God's message
to the world. To be more accurate: as God's

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text:
final edition of the scripture, His
message to the world.

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text: So, now let me give you a few examples

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text: to demonstrate the miraculous nature of this mathematical code.

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text:
Chapter 50, for example, in Quran
is entitled Q, as I mentioned before,

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text:
and is prefixed with the letter Q. When
you count the letter Q in that chapter,

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text:
you will find 57 Q's in the whole
chapter. That is 19 times 3. It's a

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text:
multiple of 19. And as I said every
single one of these mysterious letters

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text:
is found in its chapter in multiples of
19. There is another chapter in Quran, one

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text:
other chapter, that is also prefixed with
the letter Q, and that is chapter 42.

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text:
And guess what, even though chapter 42 of
Quran is more than twice as long

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text:
as chapter 50, it has the same number of Q
in it, 57.

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text:
So,...and 57 is 19 equals 3. So, the only two
chapters in Quran that are prefixed with

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text:
the letter Q have exactly the same
number, 57 and 57. And Q, we are told in

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text:
chapter 50, represents Quran. Quran is
spelled with the heavy K in the Arabic

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text:
language, which is represented by the
letter Q.

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text:
Only two chapters, 57 and 57, the total is
114. And guess what, this is the number

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text:
of chapters in Quran, 114, 19 times 6. The
letter N prefixes chapter 68, and when

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text:
we count the letter N in that chapter, we
find 133. These as you notice are

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text:
physical facts. It is not guesswork. I'm
not saying "in my opinion, chapter 68

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text:
contains 133 N's." This is a physical
fact. The chapter is initialed

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text:
with the letter N, prefixed with the initial N, and
it contains 133 Ns. 133 is a multiple

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text:
of 19. It equals 19 times 7.
Chapter 36, for example, is prefixed

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text:
with the letters Y.S., and when you count the
letters Y and S in this chapter,

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text:
the total is 285, or 19 times 15. How do you
like that? This means every letter Y,

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text:
every letter S, in this chapter, is
counted, calculated and harmonized with

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text: the other initialed chapters.

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text:
There is also an interlocking
relationship between these letters,

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text:
because you find these letters in a
number of chapters and they interlock

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text:
with each other,
and all of them give you totals that are

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text:
multiples of 19. We will find out why 19
before the end of this program. But at

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text:
this point, I would like to quote for you
from Rabbi Judah the pious, his writings

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text:
of about a thousand years ago, and it
demonstrates the common denominator

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text:
in all the scriptures, one and the same
message: the Quran, the Gospel of Jesus,

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text:
the Torah of Moses, the Psalms of David.
Let me quote for you from Rabbi Judah

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text:
the pious, where we find that the number
19 is the common denominator in all the

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text:
scriptures.
Here's what Rabbi Judah said

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text:
900 years ago "The people, the Jews in
France, made it a custom to add in the

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text: morning prayer the words: ashrei temimei derekh,

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text:
which means blessed are those who walk
the right righteous way. And our Rabbi

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text:
the Pious of blessed memory wrote that
they were completely and utterly wrong.

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text:
It is all gross falsehood because there
are only 19 times..." here it is

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text:
"...there are only 19 times that the holy
name is mentioned in that portion of the

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text:
morning prayer. And similarly, you find
the word Elohim 19 times. Similarly,

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text:
you find that Israel were called sons 19
times, and there are many other examples.

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text:
All these sets of 19..." 19, here we go.
..."are intricately intertwined

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text:
and they contain many secrets and
esoteric meanings which are contained in

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text:
more than eight large volumes." So, this
is just to give you an idea that the

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text:
number 19 is the common denominator in
all portions of the message, God's

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text: message to the world.

Video Title: 02 Witness a Miracle & World News Bulletin
Text:
